title: Battlepack section 3 — MP Regeneration

container.notes: Section 3 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 file offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill; see container-battlepack). The section is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8 = 8, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by entryCount packed 8-byte entries and zero padding to a multiple of 16 bytes (see container-st2e). Rows 0-19 use the damage layout, rows 20+ the walking layout.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: 20 + number of walking tiers (all rows share the 8-byte stride).

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 8 (0x8) for this section.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output for this section).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: mpRegenByDamage
records.where: st2e rows 0-19 of section 3: header.entryListOffset + i*8, i = 0..19

fields.name: regeneratedMp
fields.notes: MP restored when the tier applies.

fields.name: regeneratedMpSummon
fields.notes: MP restored in the variant the Workshop labels "Summon".

fields.name: unknown04
fields.notes: Not read; the Workshop writes zeros.

records.name: mpRegenByFoot
records.where: st2e rows 20.. of section 3: header.entryListOffset + (20 + j)*8, j = 0..entryCount-21

fields.name: steps
fields.notes: Steps of walking needed to regenerate 1 MP in this tier.

fields.name: mpLimit
fields.notes: Upper MP bound of the tier; tiers are ordered by it and the last one must be >= 1000.

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
Keep exactly 20 damage rows first; walking rows follow in ascending mpLimit order, the last with mpLimit >= 1000.
gaps: Exact lookup rule for walking tiers: whether current or max MP is compared with mpLimit, and whether the bound is inclusive.
Bytes 4-7 of damage rows are never read; assumed padding.
How the 20 damage rows map to Martyr / Inquisitor / Warmage (msg 96 gives only 10 Martyr tiers).
Section 3 is also referenced by name in TK L1044, but that is ARD section 3 (AI scripts), not this battlepack section.
